rows.notes: [T073] start_year 2023 (null -> 2023): CATL release dated 2023-10-29 (S1): phase 1 'officially kicked off production' after the 2023-10-27 inauguration; phase 1 design 30 GWh (existing T002 evidence for the same page: 'the first phase has a designed annual capacity of 30GWh'). capacity_by_year_json {2023: 30} unchanged (design basis). No phase-2 step: phase 2 is at EIA/signing stage.

[T073] start_year 2023 (null -> 2023): Yicai Global 2023-04-24 (S2) says production started the day before (2023-04-23) at Jiangmen. The 35 GWh in that sentence is the phase-1 design capacity; only one line was running then, so no 2023 capacity step is added. Existing capacity_by_year_json {2024: 35, 2027: 70} left unchanged (not in fields): 35 GWh (all 5 phase-1 lines in production) is dated 2024-02-27 by the Jiangmen government (T004 evidence); no source dates a smaller 2023 line count in GWh.

[T073] start_year 2022: Fujian Daily 2022-05-29 (S3): phase-1 M1 smart factory 'started production', 5 lines, 15 GWh/yr. Steps (design basis): 2022 = 15 (phase 1, S3; S5 confirms phase 1 fully in production by Apr 2023). 2023 = 45 = 15 + 30 (phase 2 30 GWh/yr 'planned to be fully built and in production this year' per S5, and Hithium's plants page S4 says 'The entire project was completed in 2023'); the 45 is my sum of the two sourced phases, no per-phase commissioning month for phase 2 is in the quoted text (v1 timeline says May 2023, investxiamen, not re-opened). S4 page is undated; its 'published' date is the earlier access date. Reported by earlier task T006: Yicai 2025-09-25 full load since March 2025 (installed 45 as of that date, unchanged).

[T073] start_year 2023: China Daily 2023-05-15 (S6): Zenergy's new battery plant (headline excerpt: 'new 25 GWh plant has started operations in Changshu') began operations on 2023-05-09. Step 2023 = 25 (design basis, original Changshu base). The 2025 = 35.5 and 2026 = 50.5 entries are the EXISTING T009 values, kept unchanged: 35.5 is the company-wide FY2025 figure that T009 parked on this row (not splittable between Changshu and Nanjing; see T009 notes, ESCALATE stands) and 50.5 is the Oct-2025 placing-article plan. No 2024 step: company said 25.5 GWh total at the April 2025 IPO (T009 timeline), i.e. no sourced 2024 change.

[T073] start_year 2023 and step 2023 = 25 (design basis): local-press feature 2025-07-25 (S7) says the CNY10bn 25 GWh power-battery line 'has been put into production in 2023' (same page that T058 used for installed 25). The page does not say whether all lines were in production at end-2023; T007/T058 timeline sources describe the first line in trial production in March 2023 and two lines fully operational within the year (chinanews sc 2023-03-30 page returned garbled text here, not used). No later step added: lines 4-5 (to 28 GWh) are in commissioning in 2026 with no sourced year/GWh split. Fetch tool extraction was used for S7; auditor please string-match.

[T073] start_year 2023: Zhejiang Economic Information Center item as reprinted by Solarbe (S8, date from URL 2025-10-22): first production line started 2023-03 and all 8 lines in production in 2025; a second reprint (itiger, date not stated) carries the same wording ('2023年3月第一条生产线投产，2024年9月完成项目土建工程竣工验收') but was not used as a source because its publication date is not shown. Step 2025 = 22 (design capacity once all 8 lines run; 22 GWh at full output per the same item and the existing MarkLines teaser evidence of T003). No 2023/2024 steps: line-by-line GWh and commissioning dates for lines 2-7 are not published (per-line split would be interpolation). So the series can credit from 2023 only through start_year, not through a GWh step.
